name: True Wind Style - Rasen Shuriken
desc: Wind damage to lineup, 10 COMBO; selected target suffers Repulse. Prompt. Chakra 40 / Cooldown 3 rounds / Battlefield cooldown 1. Consumes the primary action.

name: Sage Jutsu Shadow Clone
desc: Summons a Lightning-resistant Sage Shadow Clone. Shares a 2-round cooldown with Rasengan Barrage; uses the primary action.

name: Sage Art - Rasengan Barrage
desc: Combined Taijutsu and Ninjutsu with the clone; always causes Low Float on hit. Shares a 2-round cooldown with Summon; uses the primary action and waits while recovering.

name: Rasengan - Shoot down
desc: Chase Repulse and cause Knockdown. Cooldown 2 rounds; no Chase bonus bypass.

name: Summoning Jutsu - Toad Mouth
desc: Prompt. Chakra 20; cooldown 3 rounds; battlefield cooldown 0. Consumes the primary action. Toad Esophagus for 2 rounds: barrier creators/destroyers on both sides cannot cast Mystery. Immediately casts Toad Confrontation Chant.

name: Demonic Illusion - Toad Confrontation Chant
desc: Damage up to 2 enemies. Suppress Immunity and apply Extreme Chaos for the hit round only. Targets are protected against another Toad Chant control through the next round.

name: Giant Gallant Rasengan
desc: Cooldown 2 rounds. Uses the primary action; waits while recovering. Unavoidable lineup damage, 5 COMBO. Stackable -10% Resistance. High chance (local: 70%) of Knockdown to selected target.

name: Ninja Art - Raging Lion's Mane
desc: Cooldown 2 rounds; cannot be bypassed by Chase bonuses. At least 15 COMBO. Damage up to 4 enemies, Repulse to selected target. +1 Chase limit for allies without Chase cooldowns this round, non-stacking.

name: Senjutsu Power
desc: Round start: restore chakra limit to 100; +2% team Initiative each round, up to 10%. Cleanse Jiraiya and up to 2 other Senjutsu allies; +20 shared chakra for each.

name: Tale of Jiraiya the Gallant
desc: After defeat, revive at 30% HP after allies cast 3 Mysteries. Preserves cooldowns and cannot act again in the revival round.
